lessonTitle: §1.5 · Không gian con và biểu diễn dữ liệu
purpose: Phòng lab deterministic cho centering, orthogonal projection, residual, general-basis projector, numerical rank, reduced SVD và code audit.
learningObjectives: Kiểm tra shape và feature contract trước phép toán.
Tâm hóa đúng một observation bằng locked mean.
Kiểm Q trực chuẩn trước khi dùng QQ^T và Q^Ty.
Xác minh symmetry, idempotence và action của projector.
So sánh orthonormal-basis và general-basis coordinates.
Tính residual score cho normal và mismatch samples.
Phân biệt floating-point rank và numerical rank under tau.
Kiểm reduced-SVD reconstruction và retained energy.
Phát hiện các lỗi centering, transpose, projector và threshold bị ẩn.

canonicalCode.title: Pipeline chuẩn có assertion
canonicalCode.code:
import numpy as np

# Locked case data
mu = np.array([0.4, 0.35, 0.45, 0.3], dtype=float)
Q = np.array([
    [0.5,  0.5],
    [0.5, -0.5],
    [0.5,  0.5],
    [0.5, -0.5],
], dtype=float)
B = np.array([
    [1.0, 1.0],
    [1.0, 0.0],
    [1.0, 1.0],
    [1.0, 0.0],
], dtype=float)
x_normal = np.array([0.62, 0.74, 0.63, 0.71], dtype=float)
x_mismatch = np.array([0.9, 0.6, 0.55, 0.85], dtype=float)
Xc = np.array([
    [ 0.205,   0.415,   0.195,   0.385],
    [-0.205,  -0.415,  -0.195,  -0.385],
    [ 0.3525,  0.0375,  0.3475,  0.0625],
    [-0.3525, -0.0375, -0.3475, -0.0625],
    [-0.09,    0.305,  -0.11,    0.295],
    [ 0.09,   -0.305,   0.11,   -0.295],
    [ 0.395,   0.315,   0.405,   0.285],
    [-0.395,  -0.315,  -0.405,  -0.285],
], dtype=float)

ATOL = 1e-12
SVD_ATOL = 1e-10
TAU = 0.05
GAMMA_DEMO = 0.1

assert mu.shape == (4,)
assert Q.shape == (4, 2)
assert B.shape == (4, 2)
assert x_normal.shape == x_mismatch.shape == (4,)
assert Xc.shape == (8, 4)  # samples as rows
assert np.allclose(Xc.mean(axis=0), np.zeros(4), atol=ATOL)

# Orthonormal-basis checks
I2 = np.eye(2)
assert np.allclose(Q.T @ Q, I2, atol=ATOL)
P = Q @ Q.T
assert P.shape == (4, 4)
assert np.allclose(P.T, P, atol=ATOL)
assert np.allclose(P @ P, P, atol=ATOL)
assert np.allclose(P @ Q, Q, atol=ATOL)

def project_affine(x: np.ndarray) -> dict:
    assert x.shape == mu.shape
    y = x - mu
    z = Q.T @ y
    y_hat = P @ y
    r = y - y_hat
    score = float(np.linalg.norm(r, ord=2))
    assert np.allclose(y, y_hat + r, atol=ATOL)
    assert np.allclose(Q.T @ r, np.zeros(2), atol=ATOL)
    return {
        'y': y,
        'z': z,
        'y_hat': y_hat,
        'r': r,
        'score': score,
    }

normal = project_affine(x_normal)
mismatch = project_affine(x_mismatch)

assert np.allclose(normal['y'], [0.22, 0.39, 0.18, 0.41], atol=ATOL)
assert np.allclose(normal['z'], [0.6, -0.2], atol=ATOL)
assert np.allclose(normal['y_hat'], [0.2, 0.4, 0.2, 0.4], atol=ATOL)
assert np.allclose(normal['r'], [0.02, -0.01, -0.02, 0.01], atol=ATOL)
assert np.isclose(normal['score'], 0.0316227766016838, atol=ATOL)

assert np.allclose(mismatch['y'], [0.5, 0.25, 0.1, 0.55], atol=ATOL)
assert np.allclose(mismatch['z'], [0.7, -0.1], atol=ATOL)
assert np.allclose(mismatch['y_hat'], [0.3, 0.4, 0.3, 0.4], atol=ATOL)
assert np.allclose(mismatch['r'], [0.2, -0.15, -0.2, 0.15], atol=ATOL)
assert np.isclose(mismatch['score'], 0.3535533905932738, atol=ATOL)

assert normal['score'] < GAMMA_DEMO
assert mismatch['score'] > GAMMA_DEMO

# General full-column-rank basis: solve, do not explicitly invert by default
gram = B.T @ B
assert np.linalg.matrix_rank(B) == 2
normal_c = np.linalg.solve(gram, B.T @ normal['y'])
P_general = B @ np.linalg.solve(gram, B.T)
assert np.allclose(normal_c, [0.4, -0.2], atol=ATOL)
assert np.allclose(P_general, P, atol=ATOL)
assert not np.allclose(B @ B.T, P, atol=ATOL)

# Reduced SVD and rank language
U, s, Vh = np.linalg.svd(Xc, full_matrices=False)
assert U.shape == (8, 4)
assert s.shape == (4,)
assert Vh.shape == (4, 4)
assert np.all(s[:-1] >= s[1:])
assert np.allclose(U @ np.diag(s) @ Vh, Xc, atol=SVD_ATOL)
assert np.allclose(s, [1.44955817, 0.77504298, 0.03505112, 0.00330126], atol=5e-9)

floating_rank = int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(Xc))
numerical_rank_tau = int(np.sum(s > TAU))
rho2 = float(np.sum(s[:2] ** 2) / np.sum(s ** 2))

assert floating_rank == 4
assert numerical_rank_tau == 2
assert np.isclose(rho2, 0.9995414686511285, atol=5e-10)

print({
    'normal_score': normal['score'],
    'mismatch_score': mismatch['score'],
    'floating_rank': floating_rank,
    'numerical_rank_tau_0_05': numerical_rank_tau,
    'retained_energy_k2': rho2,
})

labSequence.title: Load and validate the locked data contract
tasks: Create mu, Q, B, x_normal, x_mismatch and Xc exactly as locked.
Assert Q shape 4x2 and Xc shape 8x4.
State that rows of Xc are observations and columns are sensor features.
Verify Xc column mean is zero.
passConditions: No transpose is inserted to make an error disappear.
x vectors are identified as RMS feature vectors, not raw waveforms.

labSequence.title: Verify Q before using the shortcut
tasks: Only after this check, compute P=Q@Q.T.

labSequence.title: Verify projector invariants
tasks: Explain why symmetry and idempotence answer different questions.

labSequence.title: Project the normal sample
tasks: Compute z, y_hat, r and score.
labSequence.requiredInterpretation: The observation is well represented by the current teaching model; health is not proven.

labSequence.title: Project the mismatch sample
tasks: Compute the same pipeline for x_mismatch.
List at least four possible causes without choosing one.
labSequence.requiredInterpretation: The observation is poorly represented by the current normal-operation model; the cause is undetermined.

labSequence.title: Compare Q coordinates and B coordinates
tasks: Solve B.T@B c=B.T@y for the normal sample.
Construct P_general with solve and verify it equals P.
Verify B@B.T does not equal P.

labSequence.title: Compute SVD with explicit shape checks
tasks: Assert U, s and Vh shapes.
Explain why Vh rows correspond to feature-space directions for samples-as-rows.

labSequence.title: Separate floating rank, numerical rank and retained dimension
tasks: Write three separate statements: floating rank, numerical rank and retained-energy result.
labSequence.prohibitedStatement: The true physical rank is universally two.

brokenCodeAudits.title: Missing centering
brokenCodeAudits.code:
y_hat = Q @ Q.T @ x_normal
r = x_normal - y_hat
defects: Projects raw x instead of x-mu.
Residual is mixed between affine and linear coordinates.
brokenCodeAudits.requiredRepair: Compute y=x_normal-mu, then project y. Reconstruct raw space as mu+y_hat if needed.

brokenCodeAudits.title: Using BB^T as a general projector
brokenCodeAudits.code:
P_bad = B @ B.T
y_hat = P_bad @ y
defects: P_bad is not the locked orthogonal projector.
brokenCodeAudits.requiredRepair: Use B @ solve(B.T@B, B.T), or orthonormalize the columns and use QQ^T.

brokenCodeAudits.title: Hidden sample orientation error
brokenCodeAudits.code:
U, s, Vh = np.linalg.svd(Xc.T, full_matrices=False)
feature_directions = Vh.T
defects: Transposes the 8x4 samples-as-rows matrix without declaring the new orientation.
The factor interpreted as feature directions now refers to a different space.
brokenCodeAudits.requiredRepair: Use Xc directly under the locked orientation, or restate every shape and semantic role after transposition.

brokenCodeAudits.title: Undeclared rank threshold
defects: Does not identify this as numerical rank.
Does not name Xc or the samples-as-rows orientation.
Does not state that 0.05 is teaching-case-specific.
brokenCodeAudits.requiredRepair: Report rank_tau(Xc)=2 under tau=0.05 for CASE_C01_L05_V1_LOCKED, alongside floating rank 4.

brokenCodeAudits.title: Shape-correct channel permutation
defects: Permutes x but not mu, Q and the model contract.
Shape checks pass while sensor semantics are wrong.
brokenCodeAudits.requiredRepair: Keep the locked order or apply the same declared permutation to every model artifact and version it.

brokenCodeAudits.title: Overclaiming from a threshold
brokenCodeAudits.code:
fault = score > 0.1
print('bearing fault' if fault else 'healthy')
defects: Turns a model-mismatch threshold into fault classification.
Declares health from a low residual.
Ignores operating regime and unmeasured faults.
brokenCodeAudits.requiredRepair: Return a bounded model-fit label and preserve the residual vector for investigation.

completionChecklist: All arrays use the locked feature order.
Q orthonormality is checked before QQ^T or Q^Ty.
General-basis projection uses solve or an equivalent stable routine.
Normal and mismatch values reproduce the locked case.
Floating rank and numerical rank are reported separately.
Tau=0.05 and gamma_demo=0.1 are labelled teaching-case-specific.
Retained energy is not called prediction accuracy.
Residual score is not used as a unique fault classifier.
